study: Horowitz (2018) Relative Education and the Advantage of a College Degree, ASR 83(4):771-801
key_findings: Could not obtain the IPUMS CPS-ASEC 1971-2010 person-level microdata (account-required; not shared on OSF), so independent re-run of the headline regression was not possible; data_status=partial (reproduction code, occupation crosswalks, O*NET skill scores, and both paper & reproduction outputs were obtained).

Paper headline claim (Table 3, men, verbal): Four-Year Degree x College Proportion interaction = -1.648 (se .0555), i.e. negative and highly significant (t~-29.7, p<0.001); n=1,003,679 men, R2=0.339. Table 4 absolute verbal decline for a college-educated man going 8%->40% cohort college share = -0.32; decline in advantage vs no college = -0.53. Independent arithmetic checks reproduce these internally (advantage decline = -1.648*0.32 = -0.53; absolute = (0.630-1.648)*0.32 = -0.33 ~ -0.32).

The FLoRA reproduction (Huntington-Klein) reports the focal interaction degree_proportion x BA Degree as POSITIVE: 0.088, t=2.316 (0.088/0.038), p=0.019, n=1,189,425, R2=0.326 - OPPOSITE SIGN to the paper's -1.648. The reproduction's own final report states 'This fails to replicate the original result.'

The later FLoRA independent audit re-ran the reproduction code and obtained focal coefficient 0.1904, t=4.741, p=2.12e-6 - not a precise numerical match to the reproduction report's 0.088 either, though both are positive and significant (auditor: 'substantively reproduced: Yes').

Discrepancies are attributed to undocumented data-construction steps: occupation-code harmonization (Autor-Dorn <-> SOC) and CFA construction of the verbal factor (set.seed/factor scoring), plus differing sample sizes (paper men 1,003,679 vs reproduction 1,189,425, ~185k gap).

Verdict aligns with the human FLoRA 'computational issues' flag: the focal headline interaction was not reproduced - its sign flips between the paper (-1.648, negative) and the reproduction (+0.088 / +0.190, positive).
notes: Independent re-run impossible without IPUMS microdata (account-required and not hosted on OSF; reproduction is 'without author data'). Focal paper claim numerically verified only in its internal arithmetic (t, p, Table 4 effect sizes from reported coefficients), not by re-running the model. No fabricated numbers.
